flavor: Spring-assisted, half-serrated. Opens one-handed. You've opened it ten thousand times.
name: Multitool

baseEffect: Fire on demand (until fuel runs out)
flavor: The most valuable object in the post-Burn world. Guard it with your life.
name: Lighter

flavor: Not much left in the kit. Enough for one bad day.
name: Field Sutures

flavor: Crayon on printer paper: you, holding a sun. She drew it the week before the sky changed.
name: Daughter's Drawing
memory: Kitchen table, burnt pancakes. You told her the sun needed holding, and she took you literally — drew you carrying it with both hands. She was six. The sky changed three weeks later.

reveals.note: She used to pick the bitter greens by the fence. You know them now: dandelion, edible.

baseEffect: Quiet, broken-in, still holding. (Bond to unlock more.)
flavor: Broken in over three states. They fit like a promise.
name: Good Boots

baseEffect: Bond 50 unlocks something old (the knife remembers)
flavor: Grandfather's. The edge remembers.
name: Grandfather's Knife

flavor: His coil. Fifty feet of paracord, coiled the way his grandfather taught him at eight — every loop the same size. 'A knot is a promise.' He's never tied a bad one since.
name: Grandfather's Rope

flavor: Sixty years of mornings on the porch — coffee, rain or shine. 'A cup is a house you can hold.' Dented, older than you, and it'll probably outlast you too.
name: Grandma's Tin Cup

flavor: Hasn't taken it off since the sky changed.
name: Camo Jacket

flavor: Eleven years of mornings. The edge is a meditation.
name: Chef's Knife

flavor: His father carried it for forty years, then handed it over without a word — the way men in his family said everything important. Small, grey, irreplaceable.
name: Father's Whetstone

baseEffect: Fish anywhere there's water and patience
flavor: 200 yards, wrapped around a stick. Low-tech, high-yield.
name: Fishing Line

flavor: Mother's. Twisted when thinking.
name: Mother's Ring
memory: The winter the factory closed {kin} pressed this into your hand and said: fix what you can reach. She twisted it when she was thinking, which was always. You twist it now.

reveals.note: Her voice, patient: measure twice. Things can be fixed.

name: Tote Bag
flavor: Canvas, thirty-one years of bus routes. Currently holds: everything.
memory: Thirty-one years of bus routes in this canvas. The driver on the 42 used to wait when he saw you running — all those years, he waited. You never learned his name. You think about him at every campfire.

reveals.note: The depot on 5th — buses, tools, dry storage. If anyone is left, they would be there.

name: Reading Glasses
flavor: Hers. She read everything twice — contracts, can labels, your excuses. The apocalypse has fine print; she'd have read that too.
memory: You read the fine print on medicine bottles for {kin} next door, because their hands shook. Dosages, warnings, the tiny words that matter. The apocalypse has fine print too.

reveals.note: The broad-leafed weed by every path — a poultice for stings and bites. You read about it once.

name: Bus Schedule
flavor: The 42, laminated by your own hand. Eleven years of on-time departures. Kept to remind the universe about punctuality — it never learned.
memory: The 42. 6:14, 6:44, 7:14 — never late, even the last week, when the driver ran an empty bus through an empty city because the schedule said so.

reveals.note: You always know which way is home. Mostly.

name: Hard Candy
flavor: Butterscotch. Grandma doled them out like medals — good news, bad news, Tuesdays. This is the last one. It stays wrapped.
memory: Butterscotch, doled out like medals — good report card, brave dentist visit, the day the dog died. Small sweetness, on purpose.

reveals.note: You know how to make a bad day smaller for someone.

name: Spare Socks
flavor: Dad's rule: dry socks are civilization. You laughed at him for twenty years. You carry the spare pair anyway.
memory: The flood year, three days in wet boots. Your feet went white and strange. The medic packed them with yarrow and told you: dry socks are civilization. Never again, you said.

reveals.note: Yarrow — white flowers, feathery leaves. Stops bleeding. The medic taught you.

name: Dead Phone
flavor: Cracked screen, 2% forever. The last text is still on it. You've got it memorized, and you read it anyway.
memory: Cracked screen, 2% forever. The last text, unsent: 'call when you can.' It was from {kin} — your brother. You have carried the unsent message for years. Maybe he is still out there.

reveals.note: Your brother — last known heading west. Someone, somewhere, might have seen him.

name: Hoodie
flavor: Not yours. His. It still smells like dorm laundry and rain, and you are not ready for it to stop smelling like that.
memory: Dorm laundry and rain. The night the storm took the power you walked three miles home in this, soaked through, laughing. Armor, basically.

reveals.note: You can smell weather coming. Storms rarely surprise you.

name: Energy Bar Wrapper
flavor: Empty. The last real one got split three ways on the worst day, and it was somehow enough. The label gets read when you need the numbers to mean something.
memory: Empty. You used to read the nutrition label when you missed numbers — calories, protein, the math of staying alive. Funny, the math that matters now.

reveals.note: White oak mast — sweetest of the acorns, food if you know the work. You know the work.

name: Notebook
flavor: Your handwriting, from when the routes still ran. Half schedules, half apocalypse patch notes. A magnum opus nobody asked for.
memory: Route optimizations, glitch lists, apocalypse patch notes. 'DO NOT TRUST THE CACHE BY THE RIVER.' Your magnum opus, half-finished.

reveals.note: Page 12: deadfall diagrams. You remember drawing them.

name: Stethoscope
flavor: Hear a heartbeat through anything. Useful for people. Useless for the System.

name: Bandana
flavor: Sling, bandage, filter, flag. The most versatile square of cloth ever made.

name: Protein bar
flavor: Tastes like cardboard. 200 kcal of cardboard.

name: Snare wire
flavor: Thin, strong, patient. The rabbit doesn't know it's there until it does.

name: Trail mix
flavor: Nuts, raisins, chocolate. The chocolate is gone. The hope remains.

name: Binoculars
flavor: See far. The far is mostly trees. But sometimes it's dinner.

name: Marked Bus Map
flavor: Her mother's handwriting on every route — the 42 to work, the 16 to Grandma's, the night bus home. Marked so she'd never get lost. None of them go here.

name: Energy drink
flavor: 300mg of caffeine. For emergencies. Everything is an emergency.

name: Dice set
flavor: For when decisions need to be fast and blame needs to be random.

name: Tasting Spoon
flavor: Hers. Twenty years in restaurant kitchens — tap it on the pot rim twice, taste, and know. 'Salt is a decision, not an accident.' She fed hundreds on a Saturday night. Now she feeds twelve.

name: Dad's Thermos
flavor: Coffee at 5 AM, every morning for thirty years — he'd tap it twice before the first sip, like knocking before entering the day. It still keeps things hot. Hot is a memory now.

name: Photo album
flavor: Faces from before. The most valuable thing they own.
memory: Faces from before. {kin}'s wedding. Your dad asleep in the chair. The neighbor's kid with the missing tooth. The most valuable thing you own, and it weighs nothing.

reveals.note: Your sister — she was visiting the coast. The coast is far. Far is not gone.

name: Sharpened stick
flavor: a stick, whittled to a point

name: Stone knife
flavor: flint knapped to an edge, bound with vine

name: Hunting spear
flavor: long, balanced, stone-tipped

name: Kitchen knife
flavor: scavenged from a ruin, still sharp

name: Bark armor
flavor: bark lashed with vine. Better than skin.

name: Leather jacket
flavor: scavenged. Smells like someone else's life.

name: Riot gear
flavor: police surplus. Heavy, hot, stops a boar.

name: Military vest
flavor: plate carrier, no plates. Still better than nothing.

name: Sling
flavor: Two cords and a pouch. David's technology, still working.

name: Fire-hardened spear
flavor: The tip is black and hard as iron. Fire did half the work.

name: Hatchet
flavor: Chops wood. Chops other things. The edge doesn't judge.

name: Machete
flavor: Clears brush. Clears problems. Still has the price sticker.

name: Crude bow
flavor: Bent stick, twisted cord. The arrows are straighter than the bow.

name: Padded cloth wraps
flavor: Layers of cloth tied tight. Better than skin. Barely.

name: Hide armor
flavor: Cured hide, laced with sinew. Smells like work.

name: SWAT vest
flavor: Ceramic plates in a carrier that says PROPERTY OF. Nobody's property now.

name: Tinder bundle
flavor: Char cloth, fatwood shavings, dry bark. Fire in a pouch.

name: Pitch torch
flavor: Pine pitch on a stick. Burns an hour. Smokes.
baseEffect: Light in dark places. Scares most animals

name: Hand drill
flavor: Spindle and hearth board. Friction is free.
baseEffect: Make fire anywhere (takes a day part)

name: Gill net
flavor: Monofilament net, 10 feet. Illegal in twelve states. All of them gone.
baseEffect: Passive: catches fish while you do other things

name: Field dressing kit
flavor: Gut hook, bone saw, game bags. The respectful way.
baseEffect: Dress game 50% faster; meat keeps longer

name: Dried apples
flavor: Chewy rings. Tastes like fall.

name: Pemmican
flavor: Dried meat pounded with fat and berries. The original energy bar.

name: Hardtack
flavor: Flour, water, salt, baked to stone. The cracker that outlives empires.
baseEffect: 300 kcal. Break a tooth or eat forever.

name: Canned beans
flavor: The can is dented. The beans don't care.

name: Peanut butter jar
flavor: Half full. The oil separated. Stir it with a stick like an animal.

name: Trail mix
flavor: Nuts, raisins, chocolate chips (melted, reformed, still good).

name: Wedding ring
flavor: Gold band, worn thin. Inside: initials and a date. You remember the day.
memory: Gold band, worn thin. Inside: initials and a date. You remember the day — the rain, the borrowed suit, the laughter during the vows. Grief is just love with nowhere to go.

reveals.note: This one channels harder than the rest. Love with nowhere to go.

name: Mixtape
flavor: Hand-labeled in her block letters: 'FOR THE DRIVE.' No player. The songs are in your head anyway — her voice between the tracks.
memory: Hand-labeled: 'FOR THE DRIVE.' No player. The songs are in your head anyway — you hum them when you work, and the work goes faster.

reveals.note: You sing while you work. The work remembers the rhythm.

name: Dog tags
flavor: Not yours. You carry them so someone is remembered.
memory: Not yours. {kin}'s. You carry them so someone is remembered — the promise you made in the dust. {kin} would laugh at you carrying them into the apocalypse.

reveals.note: {kin} taught you to read ground. You never forgot.

name: Wool socks
flavor: Dry feet are happy feet. The first rule.

name: Rain poncho
flavor: Crackly plastic. Smells like a hardware store. Keeps you dry.

name: Crowbar
flavor: Opens doors. Opens cans. Opens arguments.

name: Venison jerky
flavor: Smoked over hickory. Chewy as a promise.

name: Hiking Backpack
flavor: A real backpack. +10kg carry. Padded straps. Hip belt. Someone loved this pack. Now it loves you.

name: Duffel Bag
flavor: Big and awkward. +7kg carry. Smells faintly of gym socks and freedom. Holds a LOT.

name: Work Gloves
flavor: Leather palms, canvas backs. Smell like every job ever done.

name: Canvas Pants
flavor: Double-kneed, thorn-proof-ish. Pockets deep enough to lose things in.
baseEffect: Carry a little more. (Bond to unlock more.)

name: Flannel Shirt
flavor: Red and black check. Warm even damp — wool doesn't care about rain.

name: Knit Cap
flavor: Hand-knit, slightly lopsided. Someone loved whoever wore this.
baseEffect: Keeps the heat in. (Bond to unlock more.)

name: Denim Jacket
flavor: Broken-in denim, brass buttons. Armor for people who don't own armor.

name: Running Shoes
flavor: Light, fast, already half-dead. Speed has a price.

name: Rain Shell
flavor: Ultralight, packs to nothing. The zipper still works. Miracles happen.

name: Hand Saw
flavor: Folding pruning saw. Cuts on the pull, like it means it.

name: Camp Pot
flavor: Dented aluminum, blackened base. Has cooked a thousand meals. Hungry for more.

name: Brass Locket
flavor: Two photos inside, both fading. Opens with a click you can feel in your teeth.
memory: Brass. Two photos inside, both fading. It opens with a click you can feel in your teeth — {kin}'s click, then your mother's, now yours.

reveals.note: The farmhouse upstate, in the photos. Root cellar, well, far from everything.

name: Lucky Coin
flavor: Worn smooth. Grandpa flipped it for every big decision and ignored it every time. Heads or tails, it always lands on keep going.
memory: Worn smooth. {kin} flipped it before every hard thing and said: heads or tails, it always lands on keep going. You have stopped checking which side lands.

reveals.note: Quiet luck follows you. Small things break your way.

name: Beat-up Paperback
flavor: A field guide to edible plants, ironically. Her copy — spine cracked at the mushroom chapter, margins full of corrections. She'd have loved being right about this.
memory: A field guide to edible plants, ironically. Spine cracked at the mushroom chapter — you were always going to learn mushrooms, someday. Someday is now.

reveals.note: Jewelweed — the orange touch-me-not by creeks. Poison ivy’s antidote. The book taught you.

name: Wood log
flavor: A solid log. Building material. Future walls start here.

name: Arrow
flavor: straight, fletched, meant for something living

name: Branch
flavor: Deadfall and pruned limbs. Burns well. Future: handles, stakes, walls.

name: Plant fiber
flavor: Stripped bark and tough stems. Future: cordage, snares, cloth.

name: Stone
flavor: Good hard stone. Sling ammo, tool heads, future foundations.

name: Fusion pellet
flavor: The System's answer to lunch. Dense, warm, faintly humming. Do NOT eat it. Burns like a tiny star.
baseEffect: Fire fuel: burns 6x as long as a log

name: Can labeled BEANS
flavor: Label says BEANS. The contents are bean-adjacent. The System is very proud of this one.

name: Wrong bandage
flavor: Seals wounds. Also seals the skin around the wound. Peeling it off is a two-person job. Worth it.

name: Audience token
flavor: A coin with your face on it. The audience voted. The System will want this back. Probably.

name: Spare battery
flavor: Powers System tech. You have no System tech. Still: dense, valuable, faintly warm.

name: Hardlight knife
flavor: Cuts like a knife. Because it decided to. The edge is light that made up its mind.

name: Medfoam canister
flavor: Spray-on second skin. Smells like ozone and confidence. Stings like a betrayal, heals like a promise.

name: Gravity hook
flavor: Pulls things toward you. Including, occasionally, things you did not aim at. Pack accordingly.

name: Fusion cell
flavor: A pellet's big brother. Do not bury. Do not drop. Do not lick. Burns for hours.
baseEffect: Fire fuel: burns 12x as long as a log

name: Contract Quill
flavor: You watched an old woman trade her wedding ring for antibiotics and sign with this — her hand shaking, the quill perfectly steady. It has excellent penmanship and terrible intentions.

name: Field suture kit
flavor: From the ambulance bag. Still packed the way you were taught — needle, thread, steady hands.
memory: You practiced on an orange. 'People are just oranges that bleed,' your instructor said, and then taught you how to not flinch. You haven't flinched since.

reveals.note: You know how to stop bleeding. You learned it properly.

name: Knife roll
flavor: His. Eight knives, every edge shaving-sharp — 'a dull knife is a tired cook.' He fed the whole block out of a kitchen the size of a closet.
memory: The dinner rush, the pass, the tickets coming faster than thought. You survived your first Saturday service at sixteen. The roll was the prize.
baseEffect: +resolve when carried; camp cooking goes further

reveals.note: You can feed people. It is what you do.

name: Carpenter's square
flavor: Steel square, edges worn bright. Your father's. It built half the porches on Alder Street, and it has never measured wrong.
memory: Your first solo frame, checked and found true. The nod that followed was the whole ceremony. Measure twice, cut once — it's in your hands now.
baseEffect: +resolve when carried; building and repairs hold better

reveals.note: Measure twice. You still hear it.

name: Trail compass
flavor: Brass compass, glass cracked but needle true. His father's. The glass broke on the last ridge they climbed together. The needle never lied, and neither did he.
memory: Lost above the fog line, visibility down to your boots. You didn't panic — just held the compass flat, found north, and walked out like it was nothing. It was not nothing.
baseEffect: +resolve when carried; harder to get truly lost

reveals.note: North is north. You can find it.

name: Dispatcher's headset
flavor: One earcup cracked. Her voice came through it on the worst night the town ever had — 'stay with me, stay with me.' It still says it, when it's quiet.
memory: You learned the voice — low, steady, unhurried. 'Panic is just information arriving too fast.' You hear it in your own voice now when it counts.

reveals.note: You read bad situations early. It is training.

name: Busker's harmonica
flavor: Dented harmonica in C. Your brother's. He played every corner that would have him, and some that wouldn't. The corners are empty now.
memory: Rain, an open case, three dollars and a sandwich. You played anyway — the street owes you nothing, so everything it gives is a gift. You still believe that.
baseEffect: +resolve when carried; music steadies the camp

reveals.note: Music steadies hands. Yours, and the camp’s.

name: Coat button
flavor: A single horn button from a winter coat. The coat is gone. The winter isn't.
memory: The last winter before the scattering. You don't talk about it. The button remembers the weight of that coat, the cold that got in anyway, and who was wearing it.

reveals.note: Some winters do not end.

name: Unnamed photograph
flavor: A photo with the faces worn soft from handling. No names on the back. There were names once.
memory: There is a name you won't say out loud anymore. The photo doesn't need you to say it. Somebody you loved didn't make it to the clearing, and this is what's left of the proof they were here.

reveals.note: You carry them. That is the whole of it.

name: Boot stone
flavor: A smooth stone, carried in the boot for years. Guilt has a weight. This is exactly that weight.
memory: You carry a guilt like a stone in the boot. So you carry a stone in the boot — the scattering took the one person you were keeping alive, and this is the shape of that. It keeps you honest.

reveals.note: Guilt is a compass too. It points at what matters.

name: Search locket
flavor: A locket with a picture inside. You open it when you need to remember what you're looking for.
memory: The last photo, the one where they're laughing at something off-camera. You'll ask the System what it wants, later. First: them.

reveals.note: You are looking. That counts for something.

name: Home key
flavor: A house key for a door that isn't here. {place} is a direction now, not an address.
memory: The key never leaves your pocket. Locks are a promise: somewhere, a door still fits this.

reveals.note: Home is a direction. You are walking it.

name: Seed packet
flavor: A packet of seeds, her handwriting on the front. Plant after last frost. As if frost were still the problem.
memory: Pressed into your hand with an order: keep people fed through winter. Seeds are a plan. Plans are how you stop being helpless.

reveals.note: You know what grows. You will prove it.

name: Phase blade
flavor: Phases through armor. The blade is only sometimes here.

name: Nanite swarm
flavor: A cloud of tiny machines. They want to help. They insist.
baseEffect: Heals 50 HP over 3 turns when used

name: Gravity well
flavor: Creates a point of intense gravity. Don't drop it.
baseEffect: Immobilizes enemies in 3x3 area for 2 turns

name: Starfall lance
flavor: Forged from a dead star. It hums with old fire.

name: Genesis seed
flavor: Plant it and something grows. Something that wasn't here before.
baseEffect: Creates a food source (5000 kcal over 10 days)

name: Bow
flavor: Yew and sinew and patience. The arrow knows where it's going before you loose it.

name: Crossbow
flavor: Crank, lock, loose. Less art than the bow, more certainty. The bolt doesn't care about your form.

name: Phase sling
flavor: The pouch phases half a second ahead of your hand. Stones arrive before you throw them.
baseEffect: +35 damage, range 5, uses stones, phases through cover

name: Starfall bow
flavor: The limbs are star-metal. Arrows leave trails of cold fire. The deer never hear it.

name: Searcaster
flavor: A beam of focused starlight. It doesn't kill so much as unmake. Do NOT point at dinner.
baseEffect: +120 damage, range 8, ENERGY — chars meat, ruins carcasses

name: Crossbow bolt
flavor: Short, thick, brutal. Built for penetration, not grace.
